body:
**What is this feature?**

Widens `missing_series_evals_to_resolve` to nullable `BIGINT` in `alert_rule` and `alert_rule_version` on MySQL and PostgreSQL. Adds an integration regression test that persists 43,200 evaluations and checks both the rule and its version record.

**Why do we need this feature?**

The database columns use `SMALLINT`, while the model uses `int64`. Values above 32,767 exceed the database column range.

**Who is this feature for?**

Grafana Alerting users configuring missing-series resolution counts above 32,767 on MySQL or PostgreSQL.

**Which issue(s) does this PR fix?**:

None linked.

**Special notes for your reviewer:**

None

Please check that:
- [ ] It works as expected from a user perspective.
- [ ] If this is a pre-GA feature, it is behind a feature toggle.
- [ ] The docs are updated, and if this is a [notable improvement](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/#how-to-determine-if-content-belongs-in-whats-new), it is added to our [What’s New](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/) doc.
title: Alerting: Support missing-series resolution counts above the SMALLINT limit
